assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 김프로KIMPRO (Kim Pro) 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方／创作者：该频道背后是谁？韩国公众人物。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家（韩国）。
  5. 使用的语言（韩语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（娱乐／视频博客？）。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表性系列／作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，김프로KIMPRO 排名第 4 名，历史累计观看量约为 153B（1530 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 김프로KIMPRO 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
김프로KIMPRO — Comprehensive Dossier

1. Stable Channel ID and Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UCiVs2pnGW5mLIc1jS2nxhjg
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@kimpro828

2. Operator/Creator

  • Founder and creative lead: Kim Dong-jun (김동준, born August 28, 1986), a former performance/event planner who directed live shows including theater, shadow shows, and bubble shows for a decade before pivoting online. He personally plans, directs, and edits all videos.
  • Main on-camera co-star: Yu Baek-hap (유백합, his cousin), who also runs a separate personal channel (~19.2M subscribers) as 'KKUBI.' Both majored in acting in college.
  • Team expansion: In March 2023, Yoo Ha-young (유하영) and Jung Hee-rim (정희림) joined, forming the collective 'OK TEAM' (active until December 2024). Team member 최소율 (Choi So-jeong) is also associated.
  • Management: Exclusive contract with Soon Entertainment (순이엔티, CEO Park Chang-woo) signed November 2025. Larger brand partnerships routed through KimPro Studio, the creator's own production entity.

3. Channel Creation Date and Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel created: November 11, 2017 (dormant ~5 years; no uploads during this period).
  • First video uploaded: August 1, 2022 — a Shorts-format skit that reportedly surpassed 100 million views, and remains public.
  • The first batch of uploads were skits; many early videos gained 1–30 million views each.

4. Operating Location and Displayed Country

  • South Korea. All sources consistently confirm this. The channel's about page lists it as South Korea–based.

5. Languages

  • Primary language: Korean.
  • Dual-language posting strategy: Korean captions with English titles, deliberately designed for cross-cultural accessibility.

6. Primary Content Category

  • Entertainment / Comedy Shorts. Specific genre tags: comedy, mukbang (eating broadcasts), memes, challenges, situational skits.
  • Signature style: non-verbal, performance-based situational comedy relying on facial expressions, physical comedy, and intuitive plot progression rather than dialogue or subtitles — making content universally understandable across languages and cultures.
  • Format: almost entirely YouTube Shorts (15–60 seconds); long-form uploads are rare.

7. Content Supply Model

  • High-frequency, volume-first Shorts production model with bite-sized variety comedy.
  • Each video can take 2–3 days to shoot and edit, with multiple retakes per cut.
  • Structured team system dividing planning, filming, on-camera roles, and post-production.
  • Recurring character-driven content anchored by the mascot figure 'kkubi' (Yu Baek-hap).
  • Repetition-friendly structure optimized for repeat viewing and sharing.

8. Representative Series/Works

  • 'OK TEAM' (March 2023 – December 2024): recurring series with Yu Baek-hap, Choi So-jeong, and other cast.
  • 'Nervy Dance': serialized running gag released in emotional variations ('angry,' 'sad' versions).
  • 'Real or Fake' challenge format.
  • Collaborations with global creators such as Like Nastya.
  • Most-watched Single Short: approximately 830 million views (Dexerto estimate).
  • 2025 annual total: ~77.53 billion views (#1 globally, more than double MrBeast's ~38.1B).

evidence.snippet: KIMPRO is a South Korean YouTube channel run by cousins Kim Dong Joon and Yu Baek Hap. KIMPRO started its channel on 11 November 2017; the channel's first video was uploaded in August 2022. Genres: Comedy, mukbang, memes, challenges, situational plays.
evidence.supports: Channel identity, operators, creation date, first upload date, genres
